lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance, roughly circular clusters are organized into discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spatial distribution is denser in the mid-flank region with approximately five visible columns before the image edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a distinctive grid-like matrix across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from light pixels above to shadowed pixels below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-luminance curvilinear mark forming a semi-circular or 'U' shape is located on the mid-lateral flank, immediately posterior to the gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: The semi-circular marking is a highly unique geometric feature that deviates from the standard circular morphology of the surrounding spot constellation.
